gaps.what: Dissolves 3500 BCE naming yamnaya-culture as heir, but the Yamnaya starts 3400 BCE (Don-Volga core) and reaches the Dnieper only by 3200 BCE: the Dnieper-Donets steppe is blank 3500..3201 BCE. End the Sredny Stog at 3200 or hand its land to nobody.
gaps.why: page silent (the two pages date the replacement differently)

gaps.what: No boundary between the western (Catacomb) and eastern (Poltavka) ranges, and the successors' starts (2800 / 2700 BC) precede the Yamnaya end (2600 BC); the hand-over is drawn whole at 2600. Afanasievo, Corded Ware and the Danube-Hungary reach are undated and not drawn.

One page only (brief asks 2-3 pages per culture); same for cardial-ware-culture, cucuteni-trypillia-culture, funnelbeaker-culture, ghassulian, lengyel-culture, linear-pottery-culture, sredny-stog-culture, starcevo-koros-cris-culture, vinca-culture. A second page (a regional or period article) would firm up the confidence 2 and 1 placements.
gaps.why: not reached: page budget of the earlier run; kept unchanged by this resuming run

gaps.what: Two type sites only; the Anatolian Neolithic and Chalcolithic after 5000 BCE are undrawn (Anatolia blank 5000..3400 BCE and beyond).
The Pre-Pottery Neolithic (Jericho PPNA/PPNB, 'Ain Ghazal) ended before the 6000 BCE floor and is not drawn.
Lower Egypt is blank 4200..3800 BCE (between Merimde and Maadi).
The northern Mesopotamian Late Chalcolithic (4300-3800 BCE) has no dossier and is nobody's land until the Uruk expansion.
Western Mediterranean Neolithic after 5500 BCE (Epicardial, Danilo, Stentinello, Chasseen, Iberia) undrawn until the megalith builders (4800 BCE).

Cultures outside the brief's list but inside the era and region and not drawn: Balkan Chalcolithic (Karanovo, Hamangia, Boian, Varna, Gumelnita), Greek Neolithic (Sesklo, Dimini), Iranian plateau and Caucasus (Sialk, Shulaveri-Shomu, Maykop), Cyprus, British and Irish Neolithic, Italian and Iberian Neolithic, Scandinavian Mesolithic; the map is blank there.
